text:
Both assistants provide accurate, simplified explanations of language models and correctly identify that they are trained on unlabeled data. Assistant B goes a step further by explicitly connecting the concept to real-world applications (voice assistants, machine translation, predictive text), which better serves the goal of helping non-technical customers understand and trust the product. Its closing offer for clarification also adds a customer-centric touch. While both are strong, Assistant B’s inclusion of concrete use cases makes it slightly more effective for the stated purpose.

[[B]]
